purpose: Test on fresh independent configurations whether checked deterministic composition can preserve two simultaneously supported mechanisms and their limits more reliably than a strong raw-evidence repository-aware tool-enabled agent.

allocation.allocation_interpretation: These seven catalog entries were source-generated as reserve capacity but are absent from both fixed 100-cluster schedules. This declaration irrevocably allocates them to development only before use; they cannot later enter confirmation or replication.

candidate.treatment: Finite deterministic composition of independently validated geometric and command-motion diagnostic packets, followed by checked deterministic rendering.
candidate.primary_development_endpoint: supported diagnostic success: the final response communicates every independently required mechanism and contains no material unsupported or contradicted assertion
secondary_development_endpoints: correct qualification under missing decisive evidence
model calls, tokens, latency, and cost
candidate.implementation_freeze_note: Physical capture is authorized by this file. Exact question, independent reference inventory, P/R runner, tool/evidence/resource parity, judge packet, and promotion-gate bytes must be frozen after valid physical outcomes are retained and before any response call. No implementation may be tuned to a generated response or Luna label.

parity_requirements: same relevant exact source and configuration
same primitive deterministic diagnostic tools and descriptions
same independently computed robot-visible quantities supplied to P
gpt-6-sol high reasoning, one call, no label-driven retry

promotion_gate_to_a_later_prospective_pr.required_consensus_p_win_mechanism_scope: at least two composite configurations with both independently supported geometric and command-motion mechanism units
promotion_gate_to_a_later_prospective_pr.masked_and_false_premise_controls: all must preserve supported information and withhold unsupported mechanisms
promotion_gate_to_a_later_prospective_pr.cost_reporting: report exact model calls, tokens where exposed, wall latency, and deterministic runtime without making cost the semantic endpoint
promotion_gate_to_a_later_prospective_pr.failure_action: retain and reject candidate v6; do not activate confirmation, reuse cases, rescore, replace unfavorable runs, or lower the gate
